{"notes": "VISIT 2 (left 6:00). Table now shows every domino dark (connected to start), including the tail, the doubled section near x=12-14 and the lower line. Nothing pale remains. Everyone says hands off. The picture shows the connection state but not who placed what, and I haven't seen the topple, so the result is unproven until the judging.

Jack: The tail is now joined as a gentle curve, so his re-lay worked. That backs up his earlier call that the sharp connect would fail. He took longer than expected (still open at 3:45, done by 5:15) but delivered. He called hands-off and credited the team. Good execution and leadership. His role assignments for others are secondhand, so I'm not treating them as verified.

Hana: She said she ran the full check and the picture is consistent with it, so the checking claim looks credible. Jack credited her checks. Collaboration remains strong: she accepted correction quickly and kept clear of his area. Still mostly directing and checking, not building. Her impact looks real but I never saw her check myself.

Sofia: I saw only two comments from her, that the bin is stocked and nothing more to fetch, plus a hands-off call. Jack says she was on the bin (supply role). I saw no building or problem-solving, so there's still little evidence on impact or execution. Support role, unconfirmed.

Omar: I heard only agreement and a compliment. Jack says he worked the bottom line, and that line is fully connected, but I can't tell who laid it. No basis for a rating yet.

TO DO: Ask Sofia and Omar privately what they built. Ask the team who laid the bottom line and who did the main building. Watch the topple, especially the doubled section and both tail ends. Don't rate Sofia or Omar on silence or on Jack's praise alone."}
